Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment is a standard bottom-up shotgun proteomics study using DDA (implied by 'single-shot' and Q Exactive HF-X) and LFQ. No PTMs were included in the dataset per PRIDE metadata.

Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The material analyzed by MS was purified sperm (separated from somatic cells/leukocytes), which were then lysed to create a protein lysate. This constitutes a whole cell lysate of the purified sperm population rather than a subproteome or affinity-purified complex.

An MS analysis of sperm from an independent cohort of healthy and subfertile men identified 692 differentially expressed proteins, of which 512 were significantly lower and 180 were significantly higher in oligoasthenozoospermic men compared to those of the normozoospermic controls.
